blocks.html:
Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019 | Commercial Van Decals and Lettering

Are you sick and tired of paying for temporary advertisements/promotions? Advertising that is more annoying than interesting to your target market? We have the solution for you right here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. Although nothing in life is permanent, that doesn’t mean there aren’t things that last for years. Anyone who owns a business knows the value of an advertisement that stays for years with a one-time payment. If you’re one of those people, then vehicle wrap/decals are the answer you’re looking for.

Despite the fact that vehicle wraps or lettering & decals last for several years, there are various other advantages. Check out our blog, why you should choose decals and lettering to promote your business. It might surprise most people, but the cost is not always the most important factor.

Our recent client “Power-Wash Equipment Co. Inc.” provides quality washing equipment to its clients and their vision was to be able to show off their brand to reach more potential customers. Upon some research and weighing the pros and cons of various ways to advertise, the client decided to get commercial decals and lettering for his company van Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019.

Designers at Vinyl Wrap Toronto communicated with the client to create a digital mockup of what the decals and lettering would look like on his Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019. We used the customer’s original van as a guide to match colour and fonts. The client approved the design and we started to print and laminate the design. Then the material is passed on to our installers for installation.

Materials Used:

When it comes to our client’s pride and joys, there are to be no compromises with the quality. Vinyl Wrap Toronto only uses premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison and 3M. For this particular job, we used the following vinyl by Avery Dennison:

  • Gloss Soft Red: SW900-427-O LTR EZRS
  • Gloss Dark Blue: SW900-681-O LTR EZRS
  • Gloss Black: SW900-190-O LTR EZRS
  • Gloss White: SW900-101-O LTR EZRS

Being in the industry for years and having wrapped vehicles of all kinds of businesses, it was a fairly straightforward job for our installers to install decals on the client’s Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019.

The client kept it simple and to the point. Here are some of the features of this particular job:

  • Clearly legible.
  • Features a combination of bright colours.
  • Minimal text featuring the services offered by the company.
  • Company’s contact information.
  • Partner logos.

We installed different sized decals and lettering on both sides as well as the back of the Ford Transit 150 XLT 2019. So, the client’s company will be promoted, no matter which direction the person is looking at the van.

We’ve attached pictures of the Ford Transit after the installation of decals and lettering for you to see how you can turn your company vehicle into a canvas that you can use to promote your business.
